question: In which of the following regions in India are Tropical Evergreen Forests found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Western Ghats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Tropical Evergreen Forests** are predominantly found in regions with high rainfall and temperatures, such as the **Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and parts of the northeastern states of India**.
